shared_elements: human figure(s) depicted frontally or in profile
ornament worn on the chest or upper body
justification: Both depict anthropomorphic figures rendered in relief with incised surface detail suggesting garments or ornaments, and both include something like a chest ornament or pendant motif on the torso. But A is a multi-figure narrative scene in low relief with profile figures interacting (one gesturing toward another, attendants holding vessels and implements) arranged in a horizontal register, whereas B is a single massive frontal figure with a blocky head, headdress-like incisions and concentric disc and arc motifs across the chest and abdomen — different composition, viewpoint convention and figural proportions entirely.
